family: VT-15 Post-maneuver orbit (ML-FR-006 AC5, ML-FR-010 AC3)
description: Moderately elliptical, inclined (general case), ν₀ = 1 rad; combined burn Δv_RSW = [30, -60, 45] m/s at t_s = 0 s.
status: New dataset version (tolerances.md §4.1 item 5), committed before any engine run on it (§4.1 item 1; ML-TASK-018 part D2 phase 1). Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

constants.source: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)

inputs.requestIdNote: requestId = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonicalRequestPayload(request)))) per contracts-v1.md §7.1, computed with @mission-lab/contracts canonicalRequestPayload and Node crypto SHA-256 (test code only).

model.constantsSource: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)
model.units: SI: m, m/s, s, rad, m³/s²
model.time: t_s: elapsed SI seconds from the epoch (contracts-v1.md §2)

references: Exact post-maneuver plane normal (ref/rsw.ts projection-form basis, 320-bit, rounded once)
producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

method.comparisonMode: A at m = 0: the reference applies the burn exactly to the request initialState, which the engine pre-maneuver state must equal bit-for-bit (tolerances.md §1 precondition row; checked by the test).
method.closedForm: a⁺, e⁺, plane rotation δ = atan2(|ΔvW|, v_s + ΔvS) from the exact RSW maneuver (as version 1). Plane normal ĥ⁺_ref = (r × v⁺)/‖r × v⁺‖ with v⁺ = v⁻ + ΔvR R + ΔvS S + ΔvW W, all in 320-bit, rounded once per component.
method.engineSide: Test, binary64, from the event: a⁺ = 1/(2/r − v⁺²/μ); e⁺ = ‖[(v⁺² − μ/r) r − (r·v⁺) v⁺]/μ‖; ĥ = (r × v)/‖r × v‖ from (position_m, velocityAfter_mps) and (position_m, velocityBefore_mps); ψ = atan2(‖ĥ⁻ × ĥ⁺‖, ĥ⁻·ĥ⁺) (atan2 form required, §7 VT-15).

referenceAccuracy.closedForm: 320-bit evaluation, rounded once: ≤ 1 ulp per value, below the binary64 reference share counted in every row (§7 VT-15).
